prompts: Redraw the referenced Mabinogi Royal Crystal Wing Bow (皇家水晶翅膀之弓) as one black-and-white SIMPLE LINE ART website icon. Use a very deeply curved, broad CRESCENT bow silhouette, close to a SEMICIRCLE, with pointed winglike ends and a small faceted diamond crystal at center grip. Prioritize LARGE CURVATURE: the bow must NOT look like a nearly straight sword or shallow arc. Its tip-to-tip diagonal runs from upper left to lower right, while its central grip bulges far toward bottom left; the crescent open side faces upper right. The grip is offset from the tip-to-tip line by approximately HALF the tip-to-tip distance (a semicircle). Two limb wings each have only 2-3 simple feather points; the entire silhouette is compact and wide. No round holes, no complex Celtic patterns. CRITICAL: NO BOWSTRING whatsoever, NO arrow, NO straight line connecting the two tips. The entire hollow inside this open crescent must be TRANSPARENT. Black bold clean outlines, white enclosed fill only, no color, gray shading, texture or shadows. Actual alpha-transparent background, no background rectangle, checkerboard, text or border. Square composition, centered with 10% margin, fully visible, readable at 32px. Deliver transparent PNG.

Edit this exact black-and-white bow icon: rotate the WHOLE existing bow approximately 25 DEGREES COUNTERCLOCKWISE, so its upper and lower tip locations align along a top-left to bottom-right 45-degree diagonal. Preserve this exact deep curve, central faceted diamond crystal, feathered wing tips, black outlines, white fill, transparent background. Do not straighten or redesign it. Center and fit the rotated bow on a square transparent canvas with 8% margins. No bowstring, no arrow, no added lines or objects. Keep the interior hollow completely transparent. Output a transparent PNG.
